dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: It's not fair. All those secret research projects are sucking up budgets that should be ours.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Budget?

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: Yeah, the budgets.

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: Sadly, even great things like knowledge can be thwarted by money.

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: The Akademiya has been spending more and more budgets on classified research over the past years.

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: Instead of maintaining a financial black hole, they should fund more practical disciplines like archaeology.

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: With a lack of self-reflection on history, we would get a short end in real life sooner or later.

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: Next time I apply for funding, I must get Vikram to join me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Vikram...

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: Vikram is my friend. He must be your friend, too.

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: You know how it is. As long as he's there helping with the negotiations, you can always get more funding than you expected.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've only heard the name.

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: What? You don't know about him? Hm... Well, he has been busy recently with the thing about the next Grand Conservator.

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: I don't know what other people think, but other than Lisa, who according to legends has become Mondstadt's Grand Conservator, Vikram should be the most suitable candidate.

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: After all, if the person in charge of the collections is as unreasonable as the one managing the funds, this study will be dead in the water.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's my first time hearing this name.

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: What? There are people in Sumeru City who haven't heard of Vikram? Well... Maybe I'm the one who's taking it for granted, since I haven't met anyone who didn't know of him.

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: He's been in the limelight recently, and is a strong candidate for the next Grand Conservator.

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: I don't know what other people think, but other than Lisa, who according to legends has become Mondstadt's Grand Conservator, Vikram should be the most suitable candidate.

dialogues.speaker: Shatir
dialogues.text: After all, if the person in charge of the collections is as unreasonable as the one managing the funds, this study will be dead in the water.
